answer_1.quote: automatically generating commit messages becomes an important task. Over the years, many approaches have been proposed to automatically generate commit messages.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of the generated messages using four metrics: BLEU [1] (2002), Meteor, Rouge-L, Cider.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a human evaluation by following the previous works to evaluate the semantic similarity of the commit message generated by RACE and four baselines NNGen, NMTGen, CommitBERT, and CoRec. ... Specifically, we invite 4 volunteers with excellent English ability and more than three years of software development experience. Each volunteer is asked to assign scores from 0 to 4 ...
answer_4.guideline: assign scores ... from the three aspects: Informativeness (the amount of important information about the code diff reflected in the commit message), Conciseness (the extend of extraneous information included in the commit message), and Expressiveness (grammaticality and fluency).
